description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConfigResolver component related to parsing gateway endpoints, resolving setup codes, and configuration logic for a Gateway connection in an Android application.

classes.name: GatewayConfigResolverTest
classes.description: Test class for GatewayConfigResolver, containing various test cases for gateway endpoint parsing and configuration resolving.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointUsesDefaultTlsPortForBareWssUrls
methods.description: Test that a wss URL without a port defaults to port 443 with TLS.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsNonLoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test that non-loopback ws URLs over cleartext are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsTailnetCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test that tailnet addresses over cleartext ws URLs are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointOmitsExplicitDefaultTlsPortFromDisplayUrl
methods.description: Test that URLs with default ports omit the port in display URL.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test that localhost and loopback addresses over ws are accepted.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLocalhostCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test acceptance of localhost URLs.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsAndroidEmulatorCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test acceptance of Android emulator's special IP.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsPrivateLanCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test acceptance of private LAN IPs.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsMdnsCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test acceptance of mDNS URLs.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsIpv6LoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test acceptance of IPv6 loopback addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsIpv4MappedIpv6LoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test acceptance of IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsCleartextLoopbackPrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Test that bypass hosts like 127.attacker are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsNonLoopbackIpv6CleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test rejection of non-loopback IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLinkLocalIpv6ZoneCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test acceptance of IPv6 link-local addresses with zone identifiers.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsSecureIpv6ZoneUrls
methods.description: Test acceptance of secure wss URLs with zone identifiers.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsUnspecifiedIpv4CleartextHttpUrls
methods.description: Test that 0.0.0.0 URLs over http are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsUnspecifiedIpv6CleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Test that :: addresses over ws are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLoopbackCleartextHttpUrls
methods.description: Test acceptance of localhost over http.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeAcceptsRawSetupCode
methods.description: Test that raw setup code strings are accepted.

methods.description: Test resolution of setup codes embedded in JSON QR payloads.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsInvalidInput
methods.description: Test rejection of invalid setup code inputs.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsJsonWithInvalidSetupCode
methods.description: Test rejection of JSON with invalid setupCode field.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsJsonWithNonStringSetupCode
methods.description: Test rejection when setupCode in JSON is not a string.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsNonLoopbackCleartextGateway
methods.description: Test rejection of non-loopback cleartext gateway URLs.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResultFlagsInsecureRemoteGateway
methods.description: Test that insecure remote gateways are flagged.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResultFlagsInsecureRemoteGateway
methods.description: Test parsing result flags for insecure gateway URLs.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResultAcceptsLanCleartextGateway
methods.description: Test acceptance of LAN IP gateways.
